summary: Gneiss is a Hearthian found playing a banjo in a rocking chair outside their home in the Village. Gneiss is the instrument-maker for all the Travelers' musical instruments and reminds the Protagonist to tell other travelers to take care of their instruments.

behavior: Gneiss laments that every Hearthian who leaves for space is one less musician in the Village orchestra.
location: Gneiss is found playing banjo in a rocking chair outside their home in the Village on Timber Hearth.
lore: Gneiss made all the Travelers' musical instruments.
Gneiss made Chert's drums, Riebeck's banjo, Gabbro's flute, and Feldspar's harmonica.
Gneiss notes Feldspar has been missing for a long time but still remembers Feldspar playing the harmonica around the campfire.
Tektite advises the protagonist not to tell Gneiss about the harmonica music from the Dark Bramble seed in Youngbark Crater because Gneiss would not let Tektite get rid of a 'musical' seed.
Esker's signalscope log notes Esker considered asking Gneiss whether the Signalscope was broken due to uneasy harmonica music from Timber Hearth.
mechanics: Gneiss tells the protagonist that any music heard in space is from one of the space program's other travelers, and points them to the Signalscope to track them down.
Gneiss directs the protagonist to the Observatory: up the path behind the waterfall, hooking right at the Zero-G Cave.
